CommunityApplications.Profile: Unraid templates for Bindery, an open source ebook and audiobook automation server and a replacement for the retired Readarr. It monitors authors and series, searches Newznab and Torznab indexers, downloads through SABnzbd, NZBGet, qBittorrent and others, and imports into your library with proper metadata. Maintained by the Bindery author. Support and bug reports: https://github.com/vavallee/bindery/issues
